_note: Measurement on cava.design. Empty means off. The privacy page (/privacy/, /es/privacidad/) describes exactly the ones set here, so a tag never runs without the page saying so. ga4: the Google Analytics measurement ID (G-...); ads: the Google Ads conversion ID (AW-...); pixel: the Meta Pixel ID. These IDs are public: any page that loads them shows them in its source.
